Help

SaldoPilot Support

For help, report an issue through the SaldoPilot GitHub issues page.

Open support Privacy policy

Include with your report

  • Your device model and iOS or iPadOS version
  • SaldoPilot app version and build number
  • The selected app language
  • What you expected and what happened instead
  • Steps that reproduce the problem

Before reporting

SaldoPilot does not connect to bank accounts or make payments. Income and paid bills are registered manually. iCloud synchronization depends on your Apple ID and iCloud settings, and notifications require permission in system settings.

Protect your information

GitHub issues are public. Never include real transaction notes, account details, private financial information, or unedited backup files. Use general examples and anonymized amounts.
